# TokenizedBlock

> TokenizedBlock (https://tokenizedblock.space) is a web app on Base where anyone can make a "block": a B20 token born with its own face and a small deterministic brain, with its market open from birth. Every block lives on a shared map.

## Founder

- TokenizedBlock was founded by Clansy — X: https://x.com/Clansy314495853 (@Clansy314495853).

## What it does

- Make a block on Base, then trade it from the app. The user's own wallet signs every transaction; the app never holds keys.
- Blocks can be paired with Coinbase tokenized stocks (B20 tokens such as NVDAc, AAPLc, TSLAc) and with ETH, USDC and OUSD. The tokenized stocks themselves are issued by Coinbase.
- One block can be traded for another block in a single transaction; each block market crossed takes its own fee, shown before signing.

## For agents: the rails API

- `GET https://tokenizedblock.space/api/rails/plan?de=<token address or ETH>&vers=<token address or ETH>&montant=<integer, raw units of the token paid>&compte=<the wallet that will sign>`
- It returns unsigned calls built by the same planners the app uses, with the same fee guards. Nothing is signed or sent by the server; your wallet signs `aSigner`, in order.
- `etat`: `PRET` (ready to sign), `APPROBATIONS` (sign these approvals, then ask for the plan again to get the swap), `REFUSE` (the reason is in `pourquoi`), `NON_MESURE` (the chain could not be read; retry).
- Routes offered: a block against its own quote token (ETH, USDC, OUSD or a tokenized stock), USDC or OUSD to a block quoted in ETH or USDC, block to block, block to a tokenized stock, ETH or USDC to a tokenized stock with a measured Aerodrome pool (12) or a read v4 USDC pool (20 more), and such a stock back to USDC. Other pairs are refused with a reason.
- Blocks born on other launchers (any B20 absent from our own records) trade on their own pool and hook, with our 0.5% taken in the quote token (ETH, USDC, OUSD, cbBTC, TOSHI or a Coinbase tokenized stock). A quote token we cannot price is refused.
- A plan reads the chain and simulates the exact transaction: measured from 4 seconds to over a minute depending on the route (set a long timeout). Budget: 4 plans per minute per IP, 20 per minute in total; over that the answer is 429 with `retry-after`.
- The API itself is free. The fee is the one in the transaction (the block market's hook, or the route's fee), paid only when your wallet executes it.

## For agents: the MCP server, and making a block

- MCP endpoint: `POST https://tokenizedblock.space/mcp` (JSON-RPC 2.0, streamable HTTP without sessions; one request per POST). Tools: `tblock_pairs`, `tblock_plan_birth`, `tblock_plan_swap`, `tblock_creator_minimum`. Every tool is read-only: it returns unsigned calls, and your wallet signs them.
- Making a block without MCP: `GET https://tokenizedblock.space/api/naissance/plan?nom=<block name>&symbole=<ticker>&compte=<the wallet that will sign>[&paire=<ETH or a currency address>][&sel=<free text that fixes the address>]`. Currencies: `GET https://tokenizedblock.space/api/naissance/paires`.
- The plan is the whole birth, in order: create the block (createPaid), approvals, registration on the market contract, market opening. A wallet batch (wallet_sendCalls) makes it one signature. The sequence is simulated from your wallet before it is returned; `etat` is `PRET` only when every call would succeed.
- Cost, all listed in `cout`: a birth fee of 0.001 ETH (0.0007 at creation + 0.0003 at registration); a creator minimum of about $1 of the paired currency, which is a deposit and not a fee — it stays the creator's, held by the market contract, and earns 0.03% of each trade; and, for an ETH pair, 0.0003 ETH seeded into the pool. Gas is on top. For a pair other than ETH the wallet must already hold the creator minimum in that currency.
- Taking the creator minimum back: `GET https://tokenizedblock.space/api/caution?block=<block address>[&paire=<ETH or the paired currency>][&compte=<the creator wallet>]` returns its state and the unsigned call for the next step. A request stops the 0.03% share at once; the withdrawal opens 7 days later.
- A block made straight through the Base B20 factory does not pass through TokenizedBlock: these tools only plan births on this path.
